name: DuckDB
summary: Query and write a local DuckDB database file, or an in-process database, from workflows. The only network use is downloading DuckDB extensions.

settings.name: path
settings.label: Database file
settings.help: A path under the workspace, or :memory: for an in-process database.

settings.name: extensions_host
settings.label: Extension repository host
settings.help: Where INSTALL fetches extensions from; change it for a private repository.

egress.note: Reading and writing the database file needs no network. Only INSTALL of an extension reaches the repository host.

notes: Ogun already ships the builtin duckdb@1 operator, which is the way to use DuckDB in a workflow; this manifest only records the settings and the extension egress. For the hosted service see the MotherDuck connector.
